Action: You should have already completed at least step 6 of LO-07-02 (the 1-3s rejection in Postman → Folder 2). If not, do that first — it produces the alert this test inspects. Logged in as admin.
Expected Result: The OpenELIS QC Dashboard shows at least one unresolved alert (most likely the GeneXpert / HIV-VL / 1-3s alert).

Action: In OpenELIS, click Analyzers → Quality Control → QC Dashboard. Click the Alerts tab.
Expected Result: The Alerts tab shows a list of QC alerts with columns for Timestamp, Instrument, Test, Rule, Severity, Value, and Status. Each alert from your LO-07-02 testing is listed.

Action: Use the Severity filter at the top of the Alerts table to filter by Rejection only.
Expected Result: The list narrows to only Rejection-severity alerts (your 1-3s violations). Any Warning-severity alerts (like 1-2s) are filtered out.

Action: Click on one of the listed alerts and choose Resolve / Acknowledge. Pick a corrective action type and add a note. Save.
Expected Result: The alert disappears from the default Unresolved view. If you change the filter to All, the alert is still there but now marked as resolved with your note + timestamp visible.
